## Requirements

Sanction the scoped `bridge`-network cell profile as a first-class
`PodmanBackend` variant: `--network <none|bridge>` /
`S4_HELPER_NETWORK` on `hh-helper`; policy-driven `--network bridge`
from `EnvDriver::start_helper` when the attached policy declares
`net.mode = public`; the `declared_deps` admission machinery producing
the honest policy (`policy_net_mode: public` +
`residual_channels[host_bridge]` verbatim on the cell spec); `none`
the unchanged default; ADR; regression battery.

## Evidence report

The `declared_deps` egress variant is first-class machinery.
`hh-helper` admits `--network <none|bridge>` (default `none`,
`S4_HELPER_NETWORK` env fallback — flag wins, unknown → usage 2) which
`PodmanBackend.network` maps verbatim into `podman create`'s argv —
the pre-variant posture is byte-identical on every unadmitted spawn.
`EnvDriver::start_helper` derives the flag from the *attached*
containment policy via `egress_profile::podman_helper_args`
(`net.mode = public` ⇒ `--network bridge`; `none`/`mediated` argv
unchanged — `mediated` is never silently widened). The admission
`egress_profile::admit_declared_deps` is transactional: declared-deps +
owned/closed `host_bridge` residual + `local_container` class or a
typed `Unsupported` refusal; the candidate policy is validated
(`PublicWithoutResidual`/`PublicBelowPrincipal` still fire — the
validator is consulted, never bypassed) before `record.ext` is stamped
with the supplement's field spellings verbatim (`egress_profile:
declared_deps`, `cell_network: bridge`, `policy_net_mode: public`,
`declared_deps[]`). A bridge cell is structurally never labelled
`none`. ADR-0421 records the admission: scratch variant superseded,
`declared_deps`-only scope, N4 declaration, `none` preserved default,
honesty bound. The variant serves R5.58's GCE re-execution; this
ticket lands machinery only — offline, USD $0.00, no cohort claim.
